mapper.select: select id, tool_key, risk_level, approval_required, enabled, remark, created_at, updated_at from tool_policy where 1 = 1 and tool_key = #{toolKey} and enabled = 1 limit 1
select id, tool_key, risk_level, approval_required, enabled, remark, created_at, updated_at from tool_policy where 1 = 1 and id = #{id} limit 1
select id, tool_key, risk_level, approval_required, enabled, remark, created_at, updated_at from tool_policy where 1 = 1 and tool_key = #{toolKey} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into tool_policy ( tool_key, risk_level, approval_required, enabled, remark, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{toolKey}, #{riskLevel}, #{approvalRequired}, #{enabled}, #{remark}, now(), now() )
mapper.update: update tool_policy set risk_level = #{riskLevel}, approval_required = #{approvalRequired}, enabled = #{enabled}, remark = #{remark}, updated_at = now() where 1 = 1 and id = #{id}
update tool_policy set enabled = #{enabled}, updated_at = now() where 1 = 1 and id = #{id}
